variants.label: Talent Anchor
variants.description: Leans hardest on long-run skill, tee-to-green quality, and career scoring baseline.

variants.label: Recent Form
variants.description: Pushes the last 24 pre-event rounds and same-season performance higher in the stack.

variants.label: Course Fit
variants.description: Weights majors, hard-course scoring, approach profile, and course-proof samples more aggressively.

variants.label: Short-Game Risk
variants.description: Adds more protection for putting, around-the-green play, and volatility on harder setups.

variants.label: Championship Blend
variants.description: A harder-event blend that pulls baseline talent down and lifts recent, major, and tough-course evidence.

variants.label: Contender Guard
variants.description: Championship Blend plus missed-cut, blow-up, and volatility guardrails to reduce false-elite top-20 names.

variants.label: Hard-Course Guard
variants.description: Short-game and risk-aware blend for difficult scoring setups where avoiding the blow-up matters.

variants.label: Fit + Form Guard
variants.description: Heavier recent-form and course-fit blend with same-course history, tough-course evidence, and light cut-risk protection.
